package.description: Tells you whether a slowdown is your Wi-Fi, your router or your ISP, and logs every outage.
package.installationNotes: Free for 14 days, then a one-time license from the Purchase Key button in the app. Installs for the current user without admin rights; run from an elevated prompt to install for all users.

en-US.author: Copper Goose Tech
en-US.description: Tells you whether a slowdown is your Wi-Fi, your router or your ISP, and logs every outage.
en-US.installationNotes: Free for 14 days, then a one-time license from the Purchase Key button in the app. Installs for the current user without admin rights; run from an elevated prompt to install for all users.
en-US.longDescription:
Copper Goose Network Monitor learns what normal looks like on your own line, then names which box is at fault when something goes wrong: your Wi-Fi, your router, the fibre box, or your ISP. It logs every outage with its time and duration, shows live upload and download speed from the tray, and warns you before a data limit is reached.
Free for 14 days, then a one-time license. The Purchase Key button in the app opens the purchase page.
en-US.name: Copper Goose Network Monitor
